summary: South African human rights lawyer Navi Pillay won the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize, with the committee framing the award as a defence of international legal institutions. Hours later the US sanctioned the International Criminal Court, where she once served as a judge. Nick Schifrin interviews former war-crimes ambassador Stephen Rapp about her landmark rulings, Israel's furious reaction, and whether international cooperation on justice is still possible.
title: Navi Pillay wins Nobel Peace Prize after long career of investigating war crimes
